messages:
maria: quick heads-up — proposing a small change to embeddings preflight semantics. plan: accept optional `X-Embed-Dims` on ingest, use it for routing + cheap early-fail if dims mismatch against tenant capability. intent is to reduce 413s and expensive retries from splitter.

tanner: curious — how will this interact with current soft-quota routing? if header is absent we still infer dims from payload right?

maria: yes. fallback path: header present -> prefer matching dim-shard or route to mixed-dim splitter; header absent -> current inference. header only influences routing, not signing or auth.

kim: console UX question — we should surface when a tenant is sending `X-Embed-Dims` that doesn't map to their reserved dims. want a quick indicator in the embeddings route view. maybe a new telemetry tile `preflight:dim-mismatch-rate`.

console-bot: created ticket DIG-1142 for dashboard tile request (owner: kim).

samir: operationally we need metrics before wide rollout. suggest these counters: `embed.preflight.header.present`, `embed.preflight.dim`, `embed.preflight.mismatch`, `embed.routing.fallback_variant`. also histograms for `preflight.latency`.

maria: agreed. also adding `embed.routing.early_reject` for fastfail when tenant is over byte/units quota. can we make those tags: tenant_id, route, dims?

tanner: dims tag is fine, but higher-cardinality tenant_id on high-frequency metrics will blow up. use tenant_hash for metrics and full id in logs only.

olivia: product note — if we show dim-mismatch in console, include guidance: "recommended action: send `X-Embed-Dims` matching your model, or use batching hint for mixed dims". keep wording simple for non-eng customers.

maria: rollout plan: 1) instrument telemetry + local dev opt-in flag; 2) canary 5% of traffic to opt-in route; 3) monitor mismatch rate + fallback frequency for 48h; 4) flip opt-in to 50% then GA. abort if `embed.preflight.mismatch` > 0.5% or `embed.routing.fallback_variant` increases lat by >10ms p50.

tanner: add unit tests for header parsing and split-routing decision. also update client SDK docs to show header usage example: `headers: { 'X-Embed-Dims': '1536' }`.

kim: telemetry query draft for dashboard: `COUNT_IF(metric='embed.preflight.mismatch' AND timeframe='1h') / COUNT_IF(metric='embed.preflight.header.present' AND timeframe='1h')` -> show as % mismatch.

samir: I'll wire an alert if mismatch% > 0.5 for 30m and fallback rate > 2% for 30m. where should alerts go? eng-sre and eng-platform on-call.

maria: yep. pinging @samir for SLO playbook.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature/emb-preflight -> staging (build 4522).

maria: initial staging run tomorrow, will paste results. any objections to the header name? `X-Embed-Dims` vs `X-Vec-Dims`? prefer `X-Embed-Dims` for clarity.

tanner: +1 for clarity.

olivia: +1 from product. also add a small tooltip in console explaining that header is optional and only for routing hints.

kim: one more: telemetry should include sample payload sizes so we can correlate large byte payloads with mismatch/fallbacks.

maria: good call. adding `embed.preflight.payload_bytes` sample metric. will update ticket DIG-1142 with fields and kanban steps.

tanner: fine. thanks.

maria: thanks everyone. will post staging link and a tiny playbook after run.

olivia: :thumbsup:

console-bot: DIG-1142 updated (added metrics list, canary plan, dashboard mock).
